summary: Front page, Vol. XII No. 42. Target story 'R. Henri Herbert Not Left' reports Herbert was appointed a consulting member of the NJ Republican State Committee, tasked with securing a solid Black vote for gubernatorial candidate John W. Griggs and the Republican ticket statewide, sharing that work with Charles R. Robinson, the Black committee member from Camden. Rest of page covers the joint Trenton fire/police parade, the funeral of Dr. Charles H. Dunham, death of ex-sheriff Robert L. Hutchinson, a body found on the Pennsylvania Railroad tracks, a park funding dispute, and other local Trenton items.
